create_verification.description: Start an ID verification for someone new and get the link they open to photograph their ID and take a selfie. Jumio makes an account for the person; keep its id to verify them again later.
create_verification.name: create_verification

parameters.description: What Jumio checks, such as ID and selfie. Use a key your Jumio account manager has turned on for you.
parameters.name: workflow_key

parameters.description: Your own reference for this verification, such as an application number. No names, emails or other personal details.
parameters.name: customer_internal_reference

parameters.description: Your own id for the person being verified, such as a customer number. No personal details.
parameters.name: user_reference

parameters.description: A label to search and group verifications by in Jumio.

parameters.description: Only accept these kinds of ID. Leave empty for every kind.

parameters.name: id_countries

parameters.description: How long the person has to start, from 5 minutes to 60 days. Jumio's default is 30 minutes.
parameters.name: link_lifetime_minutes

parameters.name: locale

parameters.description: An https:// page to send the person to when they finish.
parameters.name: success_url

parameters.description: An https:// page to send the person to if it fails.
parameters.name: error_url

description: Verify people's identity with Jumio: send a link to photograph an ID and take a selfie, read the decision and the details on the ID, report fraud, and delete personal data on request.

jumio_verification_finished_trigger.description: Runs when a Jumio verification is finished: processed with a decision, or expired before the person completed it. Ones that finished before the workflow is turned on don't start it. With Jumio's callbacks pointed at Lodol it starts within seconds; otherwise how often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.account_id: The Jumio account (the person) it was for, for the account steps.
output.customer_internal_reference: Your reference given when it was created.
output.decision: The overall decision: PASSED, WARNING, REJECTED or NOT_EXECUTED.
output.decision_label: Jumio's label for the decision, such as TOKEN_EXPIRED.
output.id_data: What was read off the ID: name, date of birth, document number and more.
output.liveness_decision: Whether the selfie was of a live person.
output.risk_score: Risk from 0 (none) to 100 (highest); -1 if it never ran.
output.similarity: Whether the selfie matched the ID: MATCH, NO_MATCH or NOT_POSSIBLE.
output.status: PROCESSED, or SESSION_EXPIRED or TOKEN_EXPIRED if the person never finished.
output.user_reference: Your id for the person, if one was given.
output.verification: The whole verification as Jumio gives it, without images.
output.workflow_execution_id: The verification's id, for the verification steps.
output.workflow_key: The workflow it ran, such as 10011.
